component.name: cla-assistant-lite
component.description: Vendored compiled bundle of the archived contributor-assistant/github-action GitHub Action, run by .github/workflows/cla.yml.

properties.name: messagefoundry:upstream:bundle-derivation
properties.value: The vendored file is the upstream blob with a 176-byte two-line header prepended and nothing else changed. Strip the first two lines and the SHA-256 of what remains is the upstream digest above -- reproducible offline, no network and no Node.

properties.name: messagefoundry:vendored:action-yml-local-change
properties.value: action.yml is NOT the upstream file. BACKLOG #1868 changed runs.using from node20 to node24 and added a comment above it saying why; diffed against upstream on 2026-09-25, no other line differed. Its recorded digest below pins the changed file, not the upstream one.

properties.name: messagefoundry:upstream:lock-derivation
properties.value: The vendored lockfile is the upstream blob byte for byte. `git hash-object upstream-package-lock.json` reproduces the id above -- reproducible offline, and checked on every run, so the inventory below cannot be regenerated from a lockfile that is not the one at the pinned commit.

properties.name: messagefoundry:recorded-files:digest-mode
properties.value: raw bytes for .github/actions/cla-assistant-lite/dist/index.js; CRLF normalized to LF for .github/actions/cla-assistant-lite/LICENSE, .github/actions/cla-assistant-lite/action.yml, .github/actions/cla-assistant-lite/upstream-package-lock.json

properties.name: messagefoundry:provenance:limitation
properties.value: A clean audit of upstream-package-lock.json proves the DECLARED dependencies of the pinned upstream commit are clean. It does NOT prove this bundle was built from them. Reproducing an ncc/webpack build needs a Node toolchain this repository does not carry, so nobody can check that here, and no number in this record should be read as if somebody had.

properties.name: messagefoundry:provenance:exposure
properties.value: CI only, and narrower than the workflow's triggers. The bundle executes in .github/workflows/cla.yml on pull_request_target, and on issue_comment when the comment body is exactly 'recheck' or the sign-off sentence -- a privileged context holding a repository token. The workflow is also triggered by merge_group, where the step's own `if:` skips the bundle rather than running it. It is not packaged into the wheel or sdist and no engine deployment carries it.

properties.name: messagefoundry:provenance:reason
properties.value: GitHub archived the upstream repository and no maintained fork or successor exists, so the action cannot be consumed as a pinned remote `uses:`. Vendoring freezes a reviewed commit instead of depending on an archived one that could be deleted or transferred.

properties.name: messagefoundry:provenance:ledger-rows
properties.value: BACKLOG #1381 (vendoring), BACKLOG #1578 (this record), BACKLOG #1868 (action.yml runtime changed from upstream)

properties.name: messagefoundry:provenance:dependency-graph
properties.value: The lockfile is named upstream-package-lock.json, not package-lock.json, so GitHub's dependency graph does not ingest it as this repository's own manifest. It describes an upstream tree nobody here can move: the record is audit-only by construction.
